name: DEFLATE (Standard ZIP)
summary: The universal lossless compression algorithm supported by every computer, OS, and unzip utility.
analogy: Replacing repeated phrases with short shorthand abbreviations in an index notebook.
what_you_gain: 100% universal compatibility across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile without third-party software.
what_you_lose: Slower compression speeds and lower density compared to modern algorithms like Zstandard.
best_for: Archives meant to be shared with clients, colleagues, or downloaded from the web.
avoid_for: Already compressed media (JPEGs, MP4s) where it wastes CPU without saving space.
go_deeper: Standardized in RFC 1951 (ZIP Method 8). Combines LZ77 sliding-window dictionary substitution with dynamic Huffman entropy coding.
